exceptions.reason: Repository older than the policy. One A5 finding: the cap of 20 pending link requests bounds the owner's approval list. It never refuses a registered (or owner), unblocked person sending from the number typed; any other sender, including a number the portal does not know yet sending its own code, gets too_many_pending while the list is full.
